content: पद्म {%a.%} [पद्-मन्] Lotus-hued. .{@-द्मम्@} .²1 A lotus ({%m.%} also in this sense); Nelumbium Speciosum (variety red); पद्मपत्रस्थितं तोयं धत्ते मुक्ताफलश्रियम्. .²2 A lotus-like ornament. .²3 The form or figure of a lotus. .²4 The root of a lotus. .²5 The coloured marks on the trunk and face of an elephant; कालः किरातः स्फुटपद्मकस्य वधं व्यधाद्यस्य दिनाद्विपस्य <ls>N. 22. 9</ls>; .²6 An army arrayed in the form of a lotus; पद्मेन चैव व्यूहेन निविशेत सदा स्वयम् <ls>Ms. 7. 188</ls>. .²7 A particular high number (one thousand billions). .²8 Lead. .²9 <ls>N.</ls> given by the Tāntrikas to the six divisions of the upper part of the body called {%Chakras%}. .²10 A mark or mole on the human body. .²11 A spot. 12 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular part of a column. .{@-द्मः@} A kind of temple. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a quarter-elephant. ये पद्मकल्पैरपि च द्विपेन्द्रैः <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 3</ls>. .²3 A species of serpent. .²4 An epithet of Rāma. .²5 One of the nine treasures of Kubera; see नवनिधि. .²6 A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment. .²7 A particular posture of the body in religious meditation. .²8 One of the eight treasures connected with the magical art called पद्मिनी. .{@-द्मा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune, and wife of Viṣṇu; (तं) पद्मा पद्मातपत्रेण भेजे साम्राज्यदीक्षितम् <ls>R. 4. 5</ls>. .²2 Cloves.
